step1_analysis.description: A classic 5-transistor OTA consisting of an NMOS differential input pair (XM1, XM3), an NMOS tail current source (XM2), and a PMOS current mirror active load (XM4, XM5). In the context of a pipeline ADC, such amplifiers are typically used in the multiplying DAC (MDAC) stages or as pre-amplifiers for comparators.

paper_reference.title: A 16-bit 65-MS/s 3.3-V Pipeline ADC Core in SiGe BiCMOS With 78-dB SNR and 180-fs Jitter

dc_gain.description: Open-loop DC voltage gain of the OTA

sky130_expected.calculation: gm * Rout. Id_tail = 105uA -> Id_half = 52.5uA. gm = sqrt(2*270u*10*52.5u) = 532uA/V. ro_n = ro_p = 1/(0.1*52.5u) = 190kOhm. Rout = 95kOhm. Gain = 532u * 95k = 50.5 V/V = 34 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Intrinsic gain of short-channel (L=0.5u) MOSFETs in sky130 is relatively low, typically yielding 30-40 dB for a single stage.
Depends heavily on the load capacitance. Using the 100fF mentioned in the paper yields ~850 MHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Single dominant pole system with non-dominant pole at the current mirror node (N1). Mirror pole wp2 = gm_p / C_N1. gm_p ~ 320uA/V. C_N1 ~ 20fF -> wp2 ~ 2.5 GHz. Since UGF < wp2, PM > 60 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The dominant pole is at the output, and the mirror pole is at a higher frequency, ensuring good phase margin.
Determined by the tail current charging/discharging the load capacitance.
Calculated based on the tail bias voltage and resulting current in sky130.
This is a system-level metric for the entire 16-bit ADC, not measurable on a single OTA.
Applies to the clock generation circuit discussed in the paper, not the OTA.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for 5T OTA measuring DC Gain, UGF, Phase Margin, Power, and Slew Rate. Uses a large RC feedback network to establish the DC operating point for open-loop AC analysis, and alters the components to configure a unity-gain buffer for transient slew rate measurement.
step3_testbench.spice:
* 5T OTA Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N1 LABEL_NET_0 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 LABEL_NET_2 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 LABEL_NET_3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 LABEL_NET_4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}

* Connections to form 5T OTA
Vshort1 LABEL_NET_4 N1 0
Vshort2 LABEL_NET_3 N1 0

* Supplies and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBIAS LABEL_NET_1 0 0.7

* Load Capacitance
CL N0 0 100f

* Input Source
VIN IN_SRC 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 PULSE(0.6 1.2 1n 100p 100p 5n 10n)

* Input Connections
R_inp IN_SRC LABEL_NET_0 1m

* Feedback Network (Open loop for AC, Closed loop for DC)
R_fb N0 LABEL_NET_2 1G
C_in LABEL_NET_2 0 1G

.control
  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(N0)
  let phase_deg = 180/PI * cph(v(N0))
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
  meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_at_ugf find phase_deg when gain_db=0 fall=1
  let pm = 180 + phase_at_ugf
  print dc_gain ugf pm

  * OP Analysis
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * TRAN Analysis (Unity Gain Configuration)
  alter r_fb 1m
  alter c_in 1f
  tran 10p 20n
  meas tran v_max max v(N0)
  meas tran v_min min v(N0)
  meas tran t_rise trig v(N0) val=0.7 rise=1 targ v(N0) val=1.1 rise=1
  meas tran t_fall trig v(N0) val=1.1 fall=1 targ v(N0) val=0.7 fall=1
  let sr_rise = (1.1 - 0.7) / t_rise
  let sr_fall = (1.1 - 0.7) / t_fall
  print sr_rise sr_fall
  quit
.endc
.end
